provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: exact: the state is not a stabilizer state (two distinct amplitude moduli)

notes: Settles chi(T^2) = 2 with the Lean upper bound qubit_t_m2_stabRankP_le_two. |T>^2 has moduli cos^2(beta) and cos(beta) sin(beta) with beta = arccos(1/sqrt3)/2, which differ. Also proved in Lean against stabRankP 2: QubitM2Lower.qubit_t_m2_stabRankP_gt_one (equal fourth powers at 00 and 01 would force sqrt3 = -2).
